description: Find files and folders by name, extension, type, size, age or emptiness

all.description: Include hidden entries and dependency folders such as node_modules

folder.description: The folder to search; the current folder by default

larger.description: Larger than a size, such as 10KB <size>

limit.description: Show at most this many results <n>

name.description: A glob that ignores case, such as *.test.ts or src/**/index.* <glob>

newer.description: Modified within a time, such as 7d, or after a date <time>

older.description: Modified before a time or date <time>

name: files.find

output.description: What a program the command ran printed

truncated.description: Where the result was cut to fit, and how much
